integrity: No independent assessment or priority certification is asserted; all proof claims are analytical and finite numerical checks are supporting only.
scientific_limitations: Complete graph, symmetric updating, all-zero initial opinions, fixed \(0<\mu<1\); expectation-level exact variance and finite-agent one-marginal obstruction, not a full finite-population distribution theorem.
title: A finite-population disagreement pulse and a nonuniform mean-field limit in symmetric persuasion
